questions.question_text:
In $30$ replacement draws from a jar, $12$ buttons are striped.
What is the sample proportion of striped buttons, as a fraction in simplest form?

options.why: Used the eighteen non-striped draws as favourable instead of the striped draws.

questions.question_text:
A jar holds $180$ buttons.
In $24$ replacement draws, $8$ are silver.
Estimate the number of silver buttons.

options.why: Reported the sample count without scaling its proportion to the whole collection.
Divided the collection size by one-third instead of finding one-third of it.

questions.question_text: Why must each sampled button be returned before the next draw?

options.text: To keep the colour proportions unchanged between draws.
To guarantee that every colour appears equally often.
options.why: Confused stable proportions with equal frequencies for colours that may be unequal.

options.text: To make each later sample larger than the previous one.
options.why: Treated replacement as adding items rather than returning the item just drawn.

questions.solution_text:
Returning the button restores the collection before the next draw.
The chance for each colour stays the same.

questions.question_text:
In $50$ replacement draws, $14$ buttons are red and $21$ are blue.
The rest are green.
Estimate the number of green buttons in a collection of $300$.

options.why: Found the green count in the sample but did not scale it to the collection.
Scaled the combined red and blue proportion instead of the green remainder.

questions.question_text: Which replacement sample would usually give the most reliable estimate of a jar's colour makeup?

options.why: Chose a smaller sample where random variation has a greater effect.
Chose the smallest sample, which gives the least stable sample proportion.

questions.solution_text:
Larger samples are usually less affected by random variation.
The sample of $150$ draws is most reliable.

questions.question_text:
A $420$-button collection is estimated to contain $147$ dotted buttons from $60$ replacement draws.
How many dotted buttons were in the sample?

options.why: Used the percentage value thirty-five as a count out of sixty.
Used only the numerator of the simplified proportion seven-twentieths.
